_doc: SOC 2 Type II Trust Services Criteria, trimmed to what applies to a one-person SaaS
that stores customer call data, contact data and payment state.
Each control names how it is satisfied: 'auto' checks read the other patrol stages
on every run; 'evidence' checks require a file under 04_compliance/evidence/ that a
human wrote and dated. A control with neither passing is a GAP and the report says
what closes it. Score = satisfied / total, and it is meant to be embarrassing at first.

controls.name: Code of conduct and security policy exist
controls.closes_with: write the policy: scope, roles, acceptable use, review date

controls.name: Roles and responsibilities defined
controls.closes_with: name who owns security, privacy, incident response (one person can hold all three; write it down)

controls.name: Customer-facing privacy policy and terms published
controls.closes_with: URLs of the live privacy policy and terms on example.com plus the date last reviewed

controls.name: Risk assessment performed and reviewed
controls.closes_with: a risk register: asset, threat, likelihood, impact, treatment, owner, next review

controls.name: Controls monitored continuously
controls.closes_with: the Sentinel-Patrol task exists and its artifact is fresh

controls.name: Vendor and subprocessor inventory maintained
controls.closes_with: evidence/vendors.json generated from the vault's configured names, reviewed quarterly

controls.name: Secrets held in a protected store, none in code or history
controls.closes_with: zero unaccepted secrets findings at critical or high

controls.name: Data at rest encrypted (laptop disk)
controls.closes_with: BitLocker on for C:

controls.name: Access reviewed: every vendor account and who holds it
controls.closes_with: list each vendor login, the holder, MFA yes/no, last reviewed date

controls.name: Least privilege on API keys (scoped, named, rotated)
controls.closes_with: per key: scope, created, last rotated, rotation trigger

controls.name: Network boundary: services on loopback, tunnel the only ingress
controls.closes_with: zero unaccepted exposure findings at high or above

controls.name: Data in transit encrypted
controls.closes_with: every public hostname answers over HTTPS

controls.name: Endpoint protection on and current
controls.closes_with: Defender real-time on, signatures under 3 days old

controls.name: Vulnerability and patch management
controls.closes_with: Windows hotfix within 45 days; pip-audit clean is a later addition

controls.name: System activity logged and monitored
controls.closes_with: conductor/job_liveness.py runs and state/job_artifacts.json covers every scheduled job that matters

controls.name: Security events evaluated
controls.closes_with: state/findings.jsonl exists with first_seen / last_seen per finding

controls.name: Incident response plan exists and was exercised
controls.closes_with: the plan, plus one dated tabletop or real incident write-up

controls.name: Change management: code in git, changes reviewable
controls.closes_with: no repo with more than 40 uncommitted paths

controls.name: Business continuity: backups exist and are recent
controls.closes_with: newest backup under 7 days; a restore test recorded in evidence/restore_test.md

controls.name: Vendor risk assessed
controls.closes_with: for each vendor holding customer data: what they hold, their SOC 2 / DPA status, exit plan

controls.name: Data retention and deletion defined
controls.closes_with: how long call recordings, transcripts and contacts are kept, and how a customer deletion request is fulfilled

controls.name: Consent for call recording disclosed
controls.closes_with: the exact disclosure the voice agent speaks, and which states require two-party consent
